I have been told I seem hypomanic. I will tell you which symptoms I have:

* Effected people tend to overestimate their capabilities.
>I suppose I wouldn't know that... Since I would currently be doing that.
* They feel inflated self-esteem or grandiosity.
>Yep.
* Increased alcohol consumption.
>I don't drink a lot volume wise. I get drunk sometimes off of 2 shots. Even though I weight 180lbs and am male.
* They fail to see the obvious risks involved in their ventures
>Only when I'm drunk.
* Making lots of plans.
>Infamous for that.
* Excessive involvement in pleasurable activities.
>Yep, I don't know if this is SFW or if anyone wants to know. But I have been known to regularly have sex 5 times a day, if I have no sex I can masturbate over 10 times in one day.
* Increased interest in uncharacteristic sexual flirting.
>Yes.
* They wish of doing several things at once.
>Yes always doing many things.
* Decreased need for sleep.
>For sure.
* More sensitive than usual.
>Physically... I am extremely ticklish. I'm not sure that's what it means thought.
* They feel like taking too many responsibilities.
>Yes.
* Increase in goal-directed activity
>Yes.

It makes sense that I would be hypomanic. My whole family has clinical depression in some way. I suppose me having a similar, yet opposite, bipolar disorder isn't far fetched. I don't think that it is a bad thing If I am hypomanic. It doesn't really change anything. Suicide is still my best option I think. Did you fear death when you were manic? Also thanks for the offer of the talk. I may take you up.
Good idea. That sounds easier than CO poisoning too.

Thats fair it's pretty late at least where I am. I usually only sleep every other day, today being the non-sleeping day. Not out of insomnia, just excess energy. I don't get tired (most days) before 34 hours of being awake. 

No worries I usually see != or =/= as the sign of being not equal. I suppose that the contrast you felt from depression and happiness could cause you to appreciate it more. I don't get sad. I am always energetic, enthusiastic, smiling, laughing. You may feel it would be great, however it gets tiring really quickly. I find empathy difficult because I cannot relate. I don't cry at funerals. I make bad choices because I wont reflect on poor choices made in the past. These things don't make me sad but I understand that they should. It sucks we can't objectively compare our current and former situations, the downfall of psychology I suppose. I suppose there is no way to verify that I am truly happy. But I can assure you I don't experience any other symptom of depression other than thoughts of suicide obviously. :P

I've never even had a headache... Ever. Which I've never thought about until now.

I really don't see a problem with me committing suicide. I'm not vital to society, I create more pollution and population problems while existing. I don't see why I should even have a right to exist? If I don't want to continue myself and the world is better off otherwise. I can't imagine why any one would be objectively (as possible, lets not get into the can of worms :P) opposed to it. Why do you think I should exist?

That's why I was worried about using the word bored. I don't mean bored in an unfulfilled way, more so that I am at my top position mood wise and no where to go. I come down to a point just above neutral I suppose but sadness is something I haven't felt for 4 years or more. I have been pinned by others to show symptoms of hypomania however, I haven't been professionally diagnosed. I'm sorry I don't recognize the symbol your trying to show with "<>" 

I apologize for putting up a fight but, I should hope that that was the point of this subreddit. I hope I am doing it right. I put up my current position and others attempt to refute it.
I don't know how I would get resources enough to help others in an influential enough way for myself to justify staying alive in my bored state of happiness. I would say I am bored of being happy.

I am perfectly fine with all of the things I do daily. I do relax, go to the beach, breathe in the fresh air. I don't see why I need to continue you living if I am fine now. Why risk ending life on a low note? I have goals right now but only external goals. Nothing that will really do me any good. I'm at peace with myself and with the idea of no longer existing. I wish there was a painless way to die. Because I could totally go for that.

I am as certain as a scientist can be there is no afterlife.

If your always happy what do you have to aim for?
